text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, I actually won!? Wh-Wh-What should 
I do~~~?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm, this is Meisho Doto-oo. This is all 
thanks to Opera O-san, so, umm...

“The winner is the unexpected dark horse, 
Meisho Doto. However....”

This result also held a major implication. 
Yes, in other words—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... I might have been a 
bit too distracted by Opera O-chan...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Yeah. But—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Now I understand. Opera O isn't completely 
invincible. She can't become someone like 
that, and I won't let her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
We've got plenty of chances to win from 
here on out too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Right. If we just keep moving forward like 
we have with Trainer and Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"We can definitely win! We can definitely 
surpass them!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-saaan, I'm so sorry~. I never 
imagined I'd actually win.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's fine. It's totally plausible 
for you. However...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The ones I can't just overlook are those 
two...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To think she could shine so brilliantly... 
Could this be...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Is my millennial kingdom being threatened? 
My eternal kingdom...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san is... being cornered. By Top 
Road-san and Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
She never makes that kind of face. At this 
rate... she might really...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "—No. Anything but... that."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I always want Opera O-san to be composed 
and smiling happily! As my goal.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: —And for that purpose!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan, thank you for the race. 
Until next time—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Please make it in autumn! Both Ayabe-san 
and I will become much stronger by then.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course! Come on in! Now then, for 
the autumn Tokyo performance—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'll be waiting at the Tenno Sho (Autumn). 
Let's go, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes, Opera O-san!

T.M. Opera O strode away gallantly. Meisho 
Doto scurried along after her at a jog.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. We can safely assume the future 
has opened up for us now, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I've gained the confidence that I can keep 
growing from here on out without losing to 
Opera O-chan.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, looks like we can manage to keep up 
the fight!

Yeah, looks like we can give them a real 
run for their money!

text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega's presence truly is 
significant after all. Having her around 
has made the training far more intense. 
From here on...

How far the two of us can go... Whether we 
can truly reach the real summit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
This year's Autumn G1 campaign— That's 
where the real decisive battle lies.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to lose. Not to Opera O-chan, 
and not to Ayabe-san either!

I don't yet know what kind of battle it 
will be, or what awaits near the summit. 
But...

First, we'll aim for our debut race, the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn). Let's make sure our 
preparations are flawless.
